import java.util.*;

public class Harness {
    static final int VISIBLE=0, INVISIBLE=4, GONE=8, TAB_EMOJI=0, TAB_GIFS=1, TAB_STICKERS=2;
    static final Object TRANSLATION_Y=new Object();
    static class Context {}
    static class SystemClock { static long uptimeMillis(){ return 100; } }
    static class MotionEvent {
        static final int ACTION_CANCEL=3;
        static MotionEvent obtain(long a,long b,int c,int d,int e,int f){ return new MotionEvent(); }
        void recycle(){}
    }
    static class Build {
        static class VERSION { static int SDK_INT=35; }
        static class VERSION_CODES { static final int O=26; }
    }
    static class ValueAnimator { static boolean enabled=true; static boolean areAnimatorsEnabled(){return enabled;} }
    static class SharedConfig { static boolean enabled=true; static boolean animationsEnabled(){return enabled;} }
    static class AndroidUtilities { static float scale=1; static float getAnimatorDurationScale(){return scale;} }
    static class CubicBezierInterpolator { static Object EASE_OUT_QUINT=new Object(); }
    static class ObjectAnimator {
        static ObjectAnimator ofFloat(Object v,Object p,float f){ return new ObjectAnimator(); }
        void setDuration(int d){} void setInterpolator(Object i){} void start(){}
    }
    static class Type { static final int EMOJIS=1; }
    static class View {
        int visibility=VISIBLE, layoutRequests, scrolls;
        boolean attached=true, shown=true;
        int windowVisibility=VISIBLE;
        void setVisibility(int v){ if ((visibility==GONE)!=(v==GONE)) layoutRequests++; visibility=v; }
        int getVisibility(){ return visibility; }
        void setTranslationY(float y){} void select(int i){}
        void smoothScrollToPosition(int i){scrolls++;} void scrollToPosition(int i){scrolls++;}
        void scrollToPositionWithOffset(int i,int offset){scrolls++;} void stopScroll(){}
        boolean isAttachedToWindow(){return attached;} boolean isShown(){return shown;}
        int getWindowVisibility(){return windowVisibility;}
        protected void onVisibilityChanged(View v,int visibility){}
        protected void onWindowVisibilityChanged(int v){}
        protected void onDetachedFromWindow(){attached=false;}
    }
    interface IconTabProvider { boolean canScrollToTab(int position); }
    static class Adapter implements IconTabProvider {
        boolean banned;
        public boolean canScrollToTab(int p){return !banned;}
    }
    // Boundary model: AndroidX sets currentItem before settling, the public setter
    // ignores a same-item request, and swipe release calls the four-argument method.
    // It intentionally does not model rendering, velocity or actual Scroller timing.
    static class ViewPager extends View {
        static final int SCROLL_STATE_IDLE=0,SCROLL_STATE_DRAGGING=1,SCROLL_STATE_SETTLING=2;
        int current,state,selectionEvents,smoothRequests; double x,start,target; boolean fake,drag,active;
        Adapter adapter=new Adapter();
        ViewPager(Context context){}
        Adapter getAdapter(){return adapter;}
        void setScrollState(int s){state=s;}
        int getCurrentItem(){return current;}
        public void setCurrentItem(int i,boolean smooth){setCurrentItemInternal(i,smooth,false,0);}
        void setCurrentItemInternal(int i,boolean smooth,boolean always,int velocity){
            i=Math.max(0,Math.min(2,i));
            if(!always && i==current)return;
            if(current!=i)selectionEvents++;
            current=i;
            if(smooth){smoothRequests++;smoothScrollTo(i,0,velocity);}
            else{x=target=i;active=false;if(state==SCROLL_STATE_SETTLING)setScrollState(SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);}
        }
        void smoothScrollTo(int x,int y,int velocity){start=this.x;target=x;active=true;setScrollState(SCROLL_STATE_SETTLING);}
        public void computeScroll(){
            if(active){x+=(target-x)*.5;if(Math.abs(target-x)<.000001){x=target;active=false;setScrollState(SCROLL_STATE_IDLE);}}
        }
        void settle(){for(int frame=0;frame<32;frame++)computeScroll();}
        void frame(double fraction){x=start+(target-start)*fraction;}
        boolean isFakeDragging(){return fake;}
        void endFakeDrag(){fake=false;setCurrentItemInternal(current,true,true,0);}
        public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent e){
            if(drag){smoothScrollTo(current,0,0);drag=false;}return true;
        }
        void beginDrag(double x){this.x=x;active=false;drag=true;setScrollState(SCROLL_STATE_DRAGGING);}
        void release(int target){setCurrentItemInternal(target,true,true,600);drag=false;}
    }
    /* BRIDGE */
    static class Tab { int type; Tab(int t){type=t;} }
    static class Keyboard {
        ArrayList<Tab> currentTabs=new ArrayList<>();
        View emojiGridView=new View(),gifGridView=new View(),stickersGridView=new View();
        View gifTabs=new View(),stickersTabContainer=new View(),emojiTabs=new View(),emojiLayoutManager=new View();
        int[] tabsMinusDy=new int[3];
        void scrollEmojisToPosition(int i,int o){emojiGridView.scrolls++;}
        EmojiViewPager pager=new EmojiViewPager(new Context()) {
            /* POLICY */
            /* SELECT */
        };
        Keyboard(int...types){for(int t:types)currentTabs.add(new Tab(t));}
        /* GRIDS */
        int scrolls(){return emojiGridView.scrolls+gifGridView.scrolls+stickersGridView.scrolls+emojiLayoutManager.scrolls;}
    }
    static class TabStrip {
        EmojiViewPager pager; boolean smoothScroll;
        TabStrip(EmojiViewPager p,boolean smooth){pager=p;smoothScroll=smooth;}
        boolean isTabAnimationEnabled(){return pager.isPageMotionEnabled();}
        void text(int position){ /* TEXT_CLICK */ }
        void icon(int position){ /* ICON_CLICK */ }
    }
    static void check(boolean b,String message){if(!b)throw new AssertionError(message);}
    static Keyboard keyboard(){return new Keyboard(0,1,2);}
    static void resetPolicy(){SharedConfig.enabled=true;ValueAnimator.enabled=true;AndroidUtilities.scale=1;Build.VERSION.SDK_INT=35;}
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        resetPolicy();
        for(boolean icon:new boolean[]{false,true}){
            Keyboard k=keyboard();TabStrip t=new TabStrip(k.pager,true);
            if(icon)t.icon(2);else t.text(2);
            check(k.pager.active && k.pager.x==0,"tap must animate, including two-page jump");
            k.pager.frame(.27);double painted=k.pager.x;
            t.text(1);check(k.pager.x==painted&&k.pager.start==painted,"retarget from painted position");
            int scrolls=k.scrolls();t.text(1);check(k.scrolls()==scrolls,"repeat target must not reset grid");
            t.text(0);t.text(2);t.text(0);k.pager.settle();
            check(k.pager.current==0&&k.pager.x==0&&!k.pager.isPageTransitionRunning(),"last rapid selection wins");
            t.text(0);check(k.scrolls()==scrolls+1,"idle repeat retains scroll-to-top");
            int events=k.pager.selectionEvents;
            k.pager.adapter.banned=true;t.text(2);t.icon(1);
            check(k.pager.selectionEvents==events,"banned tabs remain blocked");
        }
        Keyboard legacy=keyboard();new TabStrip(legacy.pager,false).text(2);
        check(!legacy.pager.active&&legacy.pager.x==2,"non-opted-in tab strip stays immediate");
        // Touch-controlled drag remains available; release/cancel adds no autonomous
        // motion when either the app or Android's remove-animation switch is off.
        for(int policy=0;policy<3;policy++){
            resetPolicy();
            if(policy==0)SharedConfig.enabled=false;
            if(policy==1)ValueAnimator.enabled=false;
            if(policy==2){Build.VERSION.SDK_INT=25;AndroidUtilities.scale=0;}
            Keyboard k=keyboard();k.pager.beginDrag(.4);k.pager.release(1);
            check(!k.pager.active&&k.pager.x==1&&!k.pager.isPageTransitionRunning()&&k.pager.smoothRequests==0,"reduced swipe settles immediately");
            new TabStrip(k.pager,true).text(2);check(k.pager.x==2&&!k.pager.active,"reduced tap");
            k.pager.beginDrag(1.7);k.pager.onTouchEvent(new MotionEvent());
            check(k.pager.x==2&&!k.pager.drag&&!k.pager.isPageTransitionRunning(),"cancel leaves no dragging state");
        }
        resetPolicy();
        for(int lifecycle=0;lifecycle<6;lifecycle++){
            Keyboard k=keyboard();k.pager.setCurrentItem(2,true);k.pager.frame(.4);
            if(lifecycle==0)k.pager.onVisibilityChanged(k.pager,INVISIBLE);
            if(lifecycle==1)k.pager.onWindowVisibilityChanged(GONE);
            if(lifecycle==2)k.pager.onDetachedFromWindow();
            if(lifecycle==3)k.pager.finishPageTransition(); // onDestroy / adapter rebuild
            if(lifecycle==4){SharedConfig.enabled=false;k.pager.computeScroll();}
            if(lifecycle==5){k.pager.beginDrag(.8);k.pager.fake=true;k.pager.finishPageTransition();}
            String reason=lifecycle==2?"detach settles":lifecycle==4?"live setting settles":"hide settles";
            check(!k.pager.active&&k.pager.x==2&&!k.pager.isPageTransitionRunning(),reason);
            check(!k.pager.drag&&!k.pager.fake,"cleanup releases gesture ownership");
            int events=k.pager.selectionEvents;k.pager.finishPageTransition();
            check(k.pager.selectionEvents==events,"cleanup idempotent, no stale selection");
            resetPolicy();k.pager.attached=true;k.pager.setCurrentItem(0,true);k.pager.settle();
            check(k.pager.x==0,"reuse after reopen");
        }
        Keyboard changed=keyboard();changed.pager.setCurrentItem(2,true);changed.pager.frame(.2);
        SharedConfig.enabled=false;changed.pager.computeScroll();
        check(!changed.pager.isPageTransitionRunning()&&!changed.pager.active,"live setting settles");
        // No animation is even requested before layout/attachment or while hidden.
        resetPolicy();for(int hidden=0;hidden<3;hidden++){
            Keyboard k=keyboard();if(hidden==0)k.pager.attached=false;if(hidden==1)k.pager.shown=false;
            if(hidden==2)k.pager.windowVisibility=INVISIBLE;
            k.pager.setCurrentItem(2,true);check(!k.pager.active&&k.pager.x==2,"hidden programmatic selection");
        }
        // Full, filtered, singleton and empty adapters; motion never collapses a
        // RecyclerView or exposes a third grid. Every fractional swipe is covered.
        for(int[] types:new int[][]{{0,1,2},{0,2},{1,2},{2},{0},{}}){
            Keyboard k=new Keyboard(types);
            for(int pos=0;pos<Math.max(1,types.length);pos++)for(int frame=0;frame<=120;frame++){
                float offset=frame==120?0:frame/120f;
                k.checkGridVisibility(pos,offset);
                View[] grids={k.emojiGridView,k.gifGridView,k.stickersGridView};
                for(int type=0;type<3;type++){
                    boolean visible=pos<types.length&&types[pos]==type || offset>0&&pos+1<types.length&&types[pos+1]==type;
                    check(grids[type].getVisibility()==(visible?VISIBLE:INVISIBLE),"retains layout and exact visible pair");
                    check(grids[type].layoutRequests==0,"retains layout during swipe/reversal");
                }
            }
        }
        Keyboard emojiOnly=new Keyboard(0);emojiOnly.gifGridView=null;emojiOnly.stickersGridView=null;
        emojiOnly.checkGridVisibility(0,0);
        check(emojiOnly.emojiGridView.visibility==VISIBLE,"no GIF/sticker null access");
        System.out.println("PASS emoji pager: tap, swipe, reversal, lifecycle, policies, filtered pages and layout");
    }
}
